title: Zscaler and Trend Micro Deployment Guide

blocks.text: The Zscaler and Trend Micro Deployment Guide provides instructions on using Internet & SaaS (ZIA) and Private Access (ZPA) features with the Trend Micro Vision One Security Playbooks.

The Internet & SaaS and Trend Micro integration supports adaptive policy enforcement by leveraging risk insights from Trend Vision One to control users' internet access in real time via Internet & SaaS. When a user exceeds a defined risk threshold, Trend Vision One automatically triggers an action to add them to an Internet & SaaS Restricted User Group. Internet & SaaS then applies predefined policies, such as limiting access to specific websites, blocking downloads, or restricting cloud app usage.

The Private Access and Trend Micro integration enables organizations to dynamically restrict access to internal or private applications using risk insights from Trend Vision One. When a user’s Trend Micro calculated risk score exceeds a configured threshold, Trend Vision One can automatically place the user into a Private Access Restricted User Group through SCIM provisioning.
